terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.lead: The terms that apply when you use this website or work with DwiStudio.

sections.heading: About DwiStudio
sections.body: DwiStudio is an independent design and development practice based in Banjarmasin, Indonesia, operated by M. Dwi Cahya Winantio. All content, design, and development on this website are produced directly by the studio.

sections.heading: Using This Website
sections.body: You are welcome to read, share, and link to this website. The writing, photographs, code, and designs remain the property of the studio; do not republish them as your own, and please request permission before using them to train a model.

sections.heading: Prices Are Starting Points
sections.body: Prices shown on the Services page are starting prices, not final quotations. A formal proposal is provided after the project requirements have been discussed and will include the scope, estimated timeline, and cost before work begins.

sections.heading: Payment
sections.body: Projects begin after the required deposit has been paid and are completed with final payment upon handover, unless otherwise agreed in writing. The applicable payment terms will be stated in the project proposal.

sections.heading: Revisions and Timelines
sections.body: Each proposal specifies the number of revision rounds included within the project scope. Project timelines depend on the timely delivery of materials and client feedback; delays in either may result in a corresponding adjustment to the delivery schedule.

sections.heading: Ownership of Final Work
sections.body: Once the final invoice has been paid in full, the completed work becomes yours. The studio retains the right to feature the project in its portfolio unless you request otherwise. Third-party fonts, photography, plugins, and other assets remain subject to their respective licenses as specified in the proposal.

sections.heading: Materials You Provide
sections.body: You are responsible for the text, images, logos, and other materials provided to the studio, including ensuring that you have the appropriate rights to use them.

sections.heading: Limitation of Liability
sections.body: Every project is carefully built and tested before handover; however, no website can be guaranteed to remain completely free from errors or interruptions. The studio is not liable for indirect or consequential losses. Nothing in these terms removes any rights you may have under Indonesian consumer protection law.

sections.heading: Changes to These Terms
sections.body: These terms may be updated from time to time. The date shown above indicates the most recent update, and any changes will not apply retroactively to work that has already been agreed upon.

sections.heading: Questions
sections.body: For questions regarding these terms, please contact DwiStudio through the contact page.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: An explanation of the data this website collects, why it is collected, and how long it is retained.

sections.heading: In Short
sections.body: This website does not use advertising, tracking pixels, or third-party analytics. The only personal data collected comes from information you submit through the contact form.

sections.heading: Information Collected Through the Contact Form
sections.body: The contact form stores your name, email address, subject, message, date received, and whether the message has been read. No other information is stored or inferred about you.

sections.heading: Purpose of Data Collection
sections.body: Your information is used solely to read and respond to your message. Your data is not sold, shared with third parties, or used for marketing activities.

sections.heading: Data Retention
sections.body: Messages are retained for as long as they remain relevant to the communication and are deleted when they are no longer required. You may also request earlier deletion.

sections.heading: Where Your Data Is Stored
sections.body: Data is stored in the website's database within a hosting environment managed by the studio. The hosting provider processes the data on behalf of the studio as part of the services provided and is not intended to use it for any other purpose.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: The public website does not use cookies. A session cookie is used only within the admin area for the studio's internal authentication and is not used for visitors.

sections.heading: Your Rights
sections.body: You may request information about the data stored about you, obtain a copy, request corrections, or request deletion. Requests can be submitted through the contact page.

sections.heading: Changes to This Policy
sections.body: If this policy is updated, the revision date displayed at the top of the page will be updated accordingly.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: For privacy-related questions, please contact DwiStudio through the contact page.
